components.name: Project Context Source
components.purpose: Collects the project objective, constraints, current workspace context, and available verification commands before work begins.

inputs.description: The scoped outcome the operator is trying to achieve.
Known guardrails, approvals, or files that shape the work.

outputs.description: A compact context packet for planning the next work order.

components.evidence: The generated project context and manifest are present and pass validation.
components.failureMode: The work can start from stale or incomplete project context.
components.rollback: Refresh the project context snapshot or regenerate the workspace before continuing.

components.name: Work Order Planner
components.purpose: Turns a scoped context packet into a concrete work order with objective, constraints, evidence, and done criteria.

inputs.description: The project context and operator intent for the current slice.

outputs.description: A work order suitable for one focused implementation or review slice.

components.evidence: A generated work order records scope, constraints, expected evidence, and next action.
components.failureMode: The operator can start with vague scope or missing acceptance evidence.
components.rollback: Archive the generated work order and create a replacement with a narrower objective.

components.name: Verification Checkpoint
components.purpose: Records the checks that prove a work order is complete before the run is closed or handed off.

inputs.description: The active work order with acceptance criteria.
Summarized local verification output or an explicit reason verification could not run.

outputs.description: A concise evidence packet for closeout.

components.evidence: Validation output or skipped-verification rationale is attached to the run closeout.
components.failureMode: A change can be marked complete without reproducible proof.
components.rollback: Reopen the work order and run the declared checks before closing it again.

components.name: Approval Gate
components.purpose: Blocks higher-risk actions until the required human approval and evidence are present.

inputs.description: The requested action, affected surface, risk class, and stop plan.

outputs.description: The approval status and any remaining conditions.

components.evidence: The approval record names the action, evidence, risk class, and required approver.
components.failureMode: A workflow can perform external, destructive, or irreversible work without a human gate.
components.rollback: Disable the action path and return the request to draft status.

components.name: Run Ledger Closeout
components.purpose: Writes the final run status, evidence, risks, and next action after a work order finishes.

inputs.description: The evidence packet for the completed work.
The next scoped action or handoff.

outputs.description: A closeout entry that future operators can inspect.

components.evidence: The run ledger includes status, evidence, risks, and next action.
components.failureMode: Future operators lose the result, proof, or next action for the run.
components.rollback: Correct the ledger entry with a new closeout entry that preserves the audit trail.
